Built a scalable PPC operating system for 32 businesses and AI-assisted marketing applications that connect evidence to dashboards, audits and recommendations. Content strategy, client consulting and investment analysis support clear narratives, practical priorities and repeatable ways for a lean team to plan, execute and improve growth work.
